title: Role Velocity and Benefits Alignment Manual
author: Avery Chen
content:
Overview

Purpose
This manual explains Redwood's approach to accelerating new contributor impact (role velocity), mapping role levels to benefit entitlements, and the internal tools and processes that enable consistent, fast, and legally-compliant activation. The goal is a reproducible, measurable path from hire to autonomy that aligns compensation and perks with clearly defined role expectations.

Audience
This document is intended for hiring managers, people-ops partners, team leads, and platform/tooling engineers responsible for provisioning and measuring onboarding outcomes.

Scope
- Applies to all full-time employees (FTEs), contractors, and returning contributors during role re-activation.
- Covers role definition, first-90/first-365 day activation playbooks, benefits mapping, tooling matrix, and handoff checklists.

Key definitions
- Role velocity: time and quality measures for a newly hired contributor to reach defined impact milestones for their role level.
- Enablement window: the target period for completing core technical and compliance enrollments (default: 14 days).
- Level competency baseline: the set of technical and non-technical skills required for each role band (IC1–IC5, M1–M4).

Principles
1) Predictability: every role has clear success milestones and tooling templates so managers can plan ramp time.
2) Equity: benefits tied to role band and employment type (FTE vs contractor) using a documented entitlement matrix.
3) Measurability: instrumentable checkpoints and metrics to track ramp and enabling tasks.
4) Iteration: run quarterly calibration with managers and people-ops to adjust role expectations based on observed outcomes.

Role & Responsibility Matrix
(High-level responsibilities for participants in the activation lifecycle)
- Hiring manager: role onboarding plan, mentor assignment, 30/60/90 goals.
- People Ops: benefits enrollment, compensation clarification, employment paperwork, Workday/BambooHR provisioning.
- IT/Platform: Okta and device provisioning, environment access, VPN, MDM enrollment.
- Team buddy/mentor: domain-specific onboarding, codebase navigation, team norms.
- Security & Compliance: training assignments (e.g., Privacy, Secure SDLC), SSO groups.

Role Velocity Framework
Metrics to track (example targets for engineering IC2 role band):
- Time to first commit to mainline: 21 days
- Time to independently own a bug fix or small feature: 45 days
- Time to pass role competency checklist: 90 days
- Enablement window (accounts + device): 14 days

Operationalizing velocity
1) Pre-boarding tasks (assigned on offer acceptance): equipment request, Okta invite, HR forms.
2) Day 0–7: environment setup, team orientation, secure access, first codebase walkthrough.
3) Day 8–30: shadowing, small code tasks, join core team rituals.
4) Day 31–90: increasing ownership, first PR approvals as reviewer, performance check-in at 30/60/90.

First-90 Days Checklist (example for engineering)
1) People Ops: confirm benefits enrollment and payroll setup within 7 days.
2) IT: laptop delivered and configured, Okta enrollment completed, MDM policies enforced, VPN access tested.
3) Security: complete secure-coding baseline and phishing training by day 14.
4) Manager: deliver 30/60/90 goals; schedule weekly 1:1s.
5) Mentor: conduct codebase walkthrough and routing for two shadowed PRs.
6) Contributor: complete first contributor README and submit first small PR by day 21.

Mapping Role Bands to Benefits (entitlement summary)
This table is a concise mapping; full legal benefit documents live in Benefits central.

Columns: Role band | Paid time off | Parental leave | Equity eligibility | Professional development budget | Hardware allowance
- IC1–IC2 | 20 days PTO | Not eligible for enhanced parental plan | No (standard equity onboarding) | $1,000/year | $1,000 one-time
- IC3–IC4 | 25 days PTO | Eligible for enhanced parental plan | Yes | $2,500/year | $1,500 one-time
- IC5+ / Managers | 30 days PTO | Eligible for enhanced parental plan + caregiver top-up | Yes + accelerated vesting review | $5,000/year | $2,000 one-time
- Contractors (12+ weeks) | Pro-rated PTO as contract terms | No | Not eligible | $500 contractor learning stipend | Hardware per contract

Notes
- All equity and parental leave policy exceptions must be approved by People Ops and Finance.
- Benefit effective date is the employee start date; some offerings require a 30 or 90 day eligibility window.

Hiring & Onboarding Operational Playbook
Pre-offer
1) Hiring manager completes role template in the Hiring Toolkit (Confluence HR form).
2) Recruiter confirms compensation band and projected start date; People Ops pre-creates placeholder Workday record.

Offer -> Acceptance -> Pre-boarding (0–14 days before start)
- People Ops: send new-hire packet, benefits overview, and request preferred hardware.
- IT/Platform: queue device order, Okta invite, and access group pre-assignments.
- Manager: prepare 30/60/90 goals and onboarding schedule.

Day 0 to Day 7 (Enablement window)
- Mandatory: set up SSO/Okta, MDM enrollment, Slack, Jira, GitHub access, and Redwood VPN.
- Recommended: get added to team calendars and dev channels; assign buddy.

Day 8 to Day 30
- Complete initial role-specific training modules on the Learning Portal.
- Deliver your first small change: triage + PR to fix doc or small issue.

Day 31 to Day 90
- Move to owning a feature area; begin code review responsibilities.
- Manager and people-ops check in on career progression timeline and benefits usage.

Internal Tooling Matrix (required systems and key SLAs)
- Okta (SSO) — owner: platform-eng; SLA for account provisioning: 48 hours after HR approval.
- Asset Tracker (assets.redwood) — owner: IT Ops; SLA for device order: 3–7 business days.
- HRIS (Workday) — owner: people-ops; SLA: benefits enrollment completed within first pay cycle.
- Slack / Google Workspace — owner: platform-eng; SLA: immediate post-Okta provisioning.
- GitHub org — owner: eng-devx; SLA: repo access within 24 hours of team assignment.
- Secrets/Key Management (Vault) — owner: security; access request through Ticketing portal, typical approval 48–72 hours.

Provisioning Commands & Examples
- Okta group assignment (example CLI):
  redwood-admin okta assign-group --user alice@example.com --group "eng-ic2"
- Asset request (example ticket):
  POST /assets/request {"user":"alice@example.com","device":"macbook-pro-16", "spec":"m2-pro"}
- GitHub team add (example):
  gh api orgs/redwood/teams/eng-memberships --method PUT --username alice

Quality Gates and Acceptance Criteria
- Enablement gate: contributor has functioning dev environment, access to repos, and completed security training.
- Competency gate: manager-signed checklist demonstrating mastery of role baseline (technical + collaboration).
- Benefits gate: payroll and benefits active in HRIS; confirmation sent by People Ops.

Manager Playbook: 30/60/90 Check-in Template
- 30-day: environment status, early wins, blocker removal, confirmation of benefits enrollment.
- 60-day: ownership signs, code quality feedback, mentorship progress, and career conversation.
- 90-day: competency sign-off, promotion readiness (if applicable), or development plan for gaps.

Escalations & Exceptions
- If enablement window > 14 days for any reason, manager logs delay in the Onboarding Tracker and people-ops runs a remediation call within 48 hours.
- For benefit entitlement disputes, escalate to People Ops -> Head of People Ops -> Legal for final resolution.

Measurement & Continuous Improvement
- Quarterly KPIs tracked in the People Ops dashboard: average time to first PR, % hitting 90-day competency, and mean time to provision.
- A/B experiments: two onboarding templates (fast-path vs guided-path) will be run for new engineering hires in Q2 and Q3 2027.

Appendix A — Role Competency Checklist (sample bullets)
- Understand key repositories and CI/CD flow.
- Can independently run local test suite and reproduce one failing test.
- Completed two peer code reviews and received positive feedback on clarity.

Appendix B — FAQ
Q: What if my device is delayed beyond 7 business days?
A: Notify IT and your manager immediately; People Ops may approve a temporary rental device.

Q: How are contractors mapped to benefits?
A: Contractors receive prorated stipends based on contract length. See contracting guidelines in Finance and Legal.
